summary:
Farmers around the world navigate shifting temperatures, changing rainfall patterns, water shortages, extreme weather, and declining soil health. These pressures make it difficult to choose crop rotations that protect fields, conserve water, and support long‑term resilience. 

Our solution is a website that helps local farmers in Ghana with with weather information and pattern to help them decide on what crop to plant for an improved yield.

Our solution eliminate guess work by farmers and gives accurate data for decision making about irrigation and early harvest. It also track temperature and rainfall patterns and alert the farmer about risk. 
 Our project  protects the livelihoods of the millions of Ghanaians who depend on rain-fed agriculture and secures the nation's food supply against climate shocks. This project can also scale up to the continental and world level to help reduce agricultural losses and climate effect on farms and produce.
details:
HOW THE PROJECT WORKS.

Our project is a website, which uses live location of the the farmer to determine the data of the location with the help of NASA open data. It then shows the live data of what is happening at the location for the farmer to make decisions.

WHAT BENEFIT IT HAS.

With the help of our site farmers will make an informed decision about the crops which will increase yield and increase productivity.

INTENDED IMPACT OF THE PROJECT.

Economically, our project will increase yield, Reduced farm waste and Financial stability.

Environmentally, our project will help soil restore soil health, reduce deforestation and improve water conservation.

Data-Driven Decision Making, Extension officers and Government and NGO's will be able to make decision on agricultural trends, anticipate food shortages early, and deploy resources where they are needed most.

TOOLS USED.

Frontend & User Interface; HTML5 & CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript and Local Storage API.

HOW OUR PROJECT IS CREATIVE.

Agri Nexus stands out as a genuinely creative and impactful agricultural solution because it bridges the gap between complex satellite/meteorological science and practical, on-the-ground farming decisions.

FACTORS WE CONSIDERED.

To ensure the website is practical, accurate, and genuinely useful for Ghanaian farmers, Our team considered five core areas spanning local climate realities, agronomy, user accessibility, and trust.
